name: Binder campaign
blurb: A de novo protein design campaign as a graph: every tested design, how it was made, the scores that selected it, the assays that tested it, and the gaps under each claim.
about: The binder campaign graph holds one AI-run protein design campaign end to end. Designs link to the tool that drew them and the design they came from; scores link to the thresholds they were judged against; claims link to the measurements they rest on and to anything the record does not hold. Tightening the definition of a binder is a query over the claims, not a re-analysis of the results.
sample: Anthropic's scorpion-toxin binder campaign, from its public data release
